description: Claim a phase of an item as finished, with the commit it was finished at: phase build is the claim-done (Done is then offered once the verifier, which waits until its tree holds that commit, passes it); phase red claims a code item's red, and the verifier checks that its suites are red at that commit. commit is 7 to 40 lower-case hex characters, pushed first; it may be empty only for a plain item's build claim, which has no code. A red claim names no suites: they are the item's suite rows, added with item.suites.add, and a red claim is refused while there are none (goal/G40.3).
